ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Trade steps
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Reusable Pickle steps that bring a trader to the map, open the trade window and buy from it. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See TradeSteps/README.md at the repository root.
They sit under a text of their own ("Nelim's Pickle Tools: ...") so they can never be ambiguous with Pickle's steps.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps.
